verdicts.reason: Both are the same flat leaderboard strip. The two photos are shrunk to postage-stamp thumbnails, and 'ONLINE TRAINING BY / FREYA ANOUK' is tiny, hard to read and pushed into the far-right corner with a big empty gap before it. The headline is just stretched onto one line, and the original's layered yellow blocks are mostly gone. A also lays yellow bars over the left photo, which covers the woman and reads like an accidental collision. In B the yellow bar sits behind the headline, closer to the original's yellow block behind the title, though it still looks half-hidden and arbitrary.
